summary: The reviewed research does not establish a qualifying benefit for this product's assessed use. Existing human research is retained under its actual material, Physta (Eurycoma longifolia): quality-of-life, sexual well-being and testosterone trials; none studied LJ100. All three declared trials studied Physta (Biotropics Malaysia), not LJ100, and none mentions LJ100: 23243445 (109 men, 300 mg/day, SF-36 physical functioning improved), 24550993 (Physta plus Polygonum minus combination, 26 completers) and 34262417 (105 men with low testosterone, 100-200 mg/day, total but not free testosterone increased). Because the intervention is not this record's branded ingredient, no context can credit LJ100, so the record becomes reference-only with approved no-credit contexts; this removes Evidence points from products matched to LJ100. These are real tongkat ali trials, not wrong-topic PMIDs, but the brand attribution is wrong.
